 Moldova faces Faroe Islands in final Nations League group match 
 Published 
 16.11.2026 08:00 
 Sursa: fmf.md Moldova’s national football team faces the Faroe Islands away tonight in its final UEFA Nations League Group C3 fixture, with live coverage on public broadcaster Moldova 1 starting at 17:00.
 Live broadcast and studio analysis 
 The national side, known locally as the "Tricolori," concludes its group stage campaign on the road. Television commentary will be provided by Alexandru Rusu, while a live stream on the Moldova 1 Facebook page remains geo-restricted to viewers within Moldova.
 Public television coverage opens at 16:30 with a special pre-match edition of the Arena Sportivă studio show. Host Radu Galbur and Moldovan international footballer Radu Gînsari will preview the tactical stakes of the encounter, followed by halftime studio analysis.
 At 20:00, a post-match edition of Arena Sportivă will review the national squad's overall Nations League campaign alongside goalkeeper Dorian Railean and football coach Alexandru Guzun. Extended match highlights of the Faroe Islands vs. Moldova fixture will air immediately after the flagship Mesager evening newscast.
 Translation by Iurie Tataru
